MOD = 1000000007

def mpow(a, b):
    res = 1
    while b:
        if b & 1:
            res = (res * a) % MOD
        a = (a * a) % MOD
        b >>= 1
    return res

def main():
    p, k = map(int, input().split())
    if k == 0:
        print(mpow(p, p - 1))
    elif k == 1:
        print(mpow(p, p))
    else:
        order = 1
        pos = k % p
        while pos != 1:
            pos = (pos * k) % p
            order += 1
        print(mpow(p, (p - 1) // order))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
